Get railway stations

Source: R/rail-station-get.R
rail_station_get.Rd

Returns the railway stations of National Land Numerical Information (鉄道, N02) in a year, one row per station of a line, as published. The first call for a year downloads the file of that year's release (via ksjdata) and builds the table, which is then cached.

Usage

rail_station_get(year)

Source

Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, National Land Numerical Information, 鉄道データ (N02): https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-N02-2025.html. See data_sources() for the terms of use.

Arguments

year

Reference year: 2006 to 2008, and 2011 to the latest release. Releases are as of December 31 of their year. See rail_station_files() for the available years.

Value

An sf tibble with one row per station of a line:

  • year, release: The reference year and the year of its release, which is year.

  • railway_type_code: 鉄道区分 (N02_001), as published.

  • operator_type_code: 事業者種別 (N02_002), as published.

  • line_name, operator_name, station_name: 路線名, 運営会社, and 駅名, as published.

  • station_code, station_group_code: 駅コード and グループコード, published from 2022 and NA before. A group is the stations of the same name within 300 m.

  • geometry: The station as a line, in the coordinate reference system of the release: JGD2011 (EPSG:6668) from 2015. The files until 2014 have no .prj file, and are set to JGD2000 (EPSG:4612), the datum of the catalog.

Details

A station served by several lines has a row for each line. Stations are lines (the extent of their platforms) as published; take a point of them or group them by station_group_code as the model needs.

The first time in a session, the terms of use are shown. Published or processed data must credit the source (National Land Numerical Information, 鉄道データ, by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), and processed data must say that they were processed.

See also

rail_station_target() to declare the table as a target.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
rail_station_get(2020)
}
